title: connectors.calendar_list_read v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the connectors module when a calendar stream has read its account's calendar list again (about once a day), so a calendar shared with the member later reaches the schedule module. It is not a grant: connectors.capability_granted keeps meaning consent. Ids and a blob reference only: the provider's calendar ids (which can be addresses) and names are in the calendar-list v1 blob. Workspace-scoped.

connection.description: The connection (an id of the connectors module).

granted_by.description: The member who granted calendar access, whose calendars they are.

calendars.description: The calendar-list v1 document, a blob of the workspace.
